description.text: Main Courses General Physics Experiment, Computer Fundamental, Computer Programming, Linear Algebra, Probability and Statistics, Data Structure, Principles of Management Science, Economics, Management Information System, Operating System, Database Principle and Design, Database Course Project, Information System Analysis and Design, Object-Oriented Programming, Computer Communication and Network, Computer Hardware Technology, Electronic Commerce, Software Project Management, Network Programming with JSP, Operations Research, Information Organization and Retrieval, Information System Integrated Design.

duration.text: The Information Management and Information System at Soochow University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3-6 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required
